manifest_row.title: Human activity on rivers outpaces, compounds effects of climate change

screening.main_topic: The health and resilience of major river systems and the combined effects of human pressures.
screening.climate_relevance: Climate change is discussed as a contributor to changing flood and drought patterns and to river vulnerability, but the article emphasizes it alongside more immediate pressures such as dams, sediment mining, pollution, and water extraction.
screening.reason: The main article focuses on the broader range of stressors affecting large rivers rather than climate change specifically. Its climate discussion is meaningful, including comparisons of climate-driven sea-level rise with other causes of flood risk, so it is relevant as peripheral discourse.
